popup.title: June Update
popup.message: 2 new stages per level, faster content updates, and back button fixes. Enjoy learning!

notices.title: New Stages Added
notices.message: 2 new stages in every level: Beginner 9, Intermediate 7, Advanced 7, and Expert 6 stages (10 questions each). 90 new words and proverbs in total.

notices.title: App Improvements
notices.message: Web content now updates automatically without clearing cache. The back button exits the app from Home, and goes back inside quizzes and settings.

notices.title: New Daily 3
notices.message: Start a quick 3-question session and keep your streak alive.

notices.title: Review Mode Added
notices.message: Wrong answers are now saved automatically so you can review them later.
